title: croton rivinifolius var. scouleri
intro: Croton rivinifolius var. scouleri, commonly known as the "Punai tree" or "Buddha's hand tree," is a plant species that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. The Punai tree is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing fever, pain, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Croton rivinifolius var. scouleri include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
